event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: Hearing No. 31 was heard together with hearing No. 29 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ITA 217813 was represented by Alessandro Verani.
FRA 225038 was represented by Raphael Olsthoorn.
ITA 218755 did not come to the hearing. The hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The race committee was represented by Michal Jodlowski (Course Race Officer Area A).
Kacper Stanislawski (coach of FRA 225038), Giovanni Redaelli (coach of ITA 217813), and Max Jablecki (member of the race committee), attended the hearing as observers.
facts: The black flag was displayed as the preparatory signal in race 6 of the Men green fleet.

The race committee initially identified ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038 as being inside the triangle formed by the ends of the line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal.
The race committee displayed ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038's sail No. on the board.
ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038 did not race in the restarted race.
ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038 were scored BFD in race 6.

When coming ashore, the race committee upon checking the video realized that ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038 were not inside the triangle formed by the ends of the line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal.
conclusions: By wrongly identifying ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038, and scoring them as BFD in race 6 the race committee made an improper action.

ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038's scores in race 6 was made significantly worse through no fault of their own by an improper action or improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b) (1) are met.
decision: Redress is given to ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038. ITA 217813, ITA 218755, BRA 217608 and FRA 225038 are to be scored in race 6 points equal to the average, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of her points in all races sailed in the qualifying series, except race 6. No other boat’s score shall change.
